entities.title: The owner deploys the game by hand
entities.summary: The owner runs npm run deploy in games/double-cross from their own machine: it tests, builds and uploads the game.
steps: npm test (the Worker), npm run test:godot (maps and the message layer)
npm run build: Godot 4.7.2 web export, the engine split in parts, boot.js
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/double-cross/.
entities.deployedBy: The owner, from their own machine: `npm run deploy` in games/double-cross with Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates installed, with a Cloudflare token for the icelander.net account (or wrangler logged in to it). Nothing deploys from GitHub's runners: the Deploy workflow was removed (the owner's decision, 2026-11-21).
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and run npm run deploy again, or roll back the Worker's version in Cloudflare. There is no database to undo.
